scenario.title: Meredith Merrino eight-month smart-home routine

authoringAssumptions: The simulation starts on 2026-08-03 and ends on 2027-04-03 inclusive, representing eight calendar months from the chosen start date.
Meredith is modeled as living alone in a synthetic large Long Island flat.
Her work schedule is Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 at a nearby hair salon.
Her usual morning run is represented with the catalog intent evening_walk because the catalog has no dedicated running intent; the action kind is explicitly running.
Breakfast is modeled at home for conservative continuity; occasional bar breakfasts are omitted to avoid inventing an unsupported frequency.
Saturday evening aperitivo represents social time with friends; the catalog-specific Paolo intent is used as the closest available social activity.
Weather remains runtime-variable and no activity outcome is asserted.
